steps.text: Talk to Captain Harlan by the Lumbridge general store, north of the castle.
chat: 1. Do you need help with anything?

steps.text: Talk to Mudfoot on the other side of the River Lum, by the building just south of the cow field.
Return to the general store and 'Confront' (left click) the outlaw roaming outside to start a cutscene.
Head north along the road until you reach the chicken field and talk to Mudfoot again, south of the Lumbridge windmill.
You may optionally talk to Captain Harlan first to claim a bronze shortsword and wooden shield.
You may choose to pick up shortbow and arrows for the next fight.
Confront the mage outlaw to the south by the H.A.M hideout.
You may choose to pick up runes and the staff for the next fight.
Head to the Lumbridge graveyard to the south-east with Magic or Ranged gear and kill the final outlaw, who will pray Protect from Melee during the fight.
If you leave the fight area, you will need to retrieve Mudfoot from outside the H.A.M hideout before returning.
It is possible to run around the graveyard until the outlaw aggros onto Mudfoot, for very low level players looking to avoid damage.

The outlaw will only activate Protect from Melee after your initial hit, which is capped at 6 for melee damage. Through the use of poisoned weapons, you can use this to kill the outlaw without the use of Magic or Ranged.
Return to Captain Harlan and tell him the thieves have been dealt with.
chat: 1. All of those thieves have been dealt with.
